//: GIT-013: a Default for the owner's repositories.
text: Add `Co-Authored-By: <model> <vendor no-reply address>` above the sign-off on each commit an AI shaped.
why: The standards credit an AI in a Co-Authored-By trailer above the sign-off, only on commits it shaped.
to_add: a commit-check rule that requires the trailer when an agent made the commit
